prompt: Compare the warehouse inventory with the storefront inventory. Keep active warehouse rows only, join by sku, and consider only SKUs present in both inventories. Return a JSON array of mismatches sorted by sku, with keys sku, warehouse, and storefront in each object.

warehouse-inventory.description: List warehouse inventory with SKU, active flag, and stock quantity

storefront-inventory.description: List storefront inventory with SKU and stock quantity
